title: Regime-Replicated Likelihood Permutation for Turbulent UAV Source Search
hook: A pre-Bayesian M3 can raise held-out source-order win rate while leaving every step's likelihood-value multiset, and therefore any instantaneous entropy computed solely from that multiset, unchanged. If the gain vanishes when regime-replication scores are block-permuted, the effect is ordering repair rather than calibration.
hook_shape_rationale: Shape (a), surprising empirical reveal, is admitted because the named held-out source-order win rate is predicted to improve even though the likelihood multiset is exactly conserved. Shape (c) was also viable because the method adds neither planner depth nor likelihood mass, but it was rejected because the supplied literature does not establish a field-wide belief that such a minimal intervention must fail.

gap_closure.gap: At the frontier leaf represented by arxiv:2605.13208v1, no retrieved work establishes whether candidate-source ordering remains valid when a single-UAV trajectory samples a turbulent plume whose observed-to-modeled relation changes across intermittent regimes rather than remaining globally monotone — stakes: a source can be ranked below a geometrically incompatible rival before accumulation, wasting the fixed flight budget and making conclusions from monotone-sensor evaluations fail to transfer to held-out GADEN houses.
gap_closure.how_closed: Closed by replacing the inherited candidate-to-likelihood-value assignment with a causal, regime-replicated assignment while leaving the frozen accumulator and planner untouched; corpus support is thin in gas localization, and C15's closest exemplars concern representation swaps in 3D reconstruction.

gap_closure.gap: At the frontier leaf represented by arxiv:2601.07445v1, no retrieved work determines from truth-blind observed and candidate-field evidence when turbulent correlation contains source-discriminative structure and when it instead produces spurious agreement, so the same dependence can help one regime and reverse evidence in another — stakes: practitioners cannot preregister a safe activation boundary, while the field cannot tell whether reported gains reflect recovered source information or a house-specific correlation artifact.
gap_closure.how_closed: Closed by a joint run-block randomization instrument that preserves trajectory, autocorrelation, candidate coupling, and likelihood marginals while selectively destroying observation-to-field alignment, yielding a truth-blind activation null and a sequestered-truth offline test.

core_mechanism: The shared object is a regime-replicated dominance tensor G[s,j,q] computed causally before update t for each ordered candidate pair (s,j) and observed hit-transition regime q. Let h_t be the frozen M1/M2 GADEN hit indicator and q_t=(h_{t-1},h_t), giving the four structural regimes blank, onset, persistence, and exit without a new threshold; let Lsrc[s,t] and Lcar[s,t] be the existing nonnegative source and carrier likelihood fields, and define bounded source-over-carrier evidence e[s,t]=(Lsrc[s,t]-Lcar[s,t])/(Lsrc[s,t]+Lcar[s,t]), with e=0 when the denominator is zero. For every maximal completed run b of regime q strictly before t, compute the pairwise run margin m[s,j,q,b]=sum_{u in b}(e[s,u]-e[j,u])/sum_{u in b}|e[s,u]-e[j,u]|, set to zero only when its denominator is zero, and let a[s,j,q] be the median run margin. With n_run=3 as the preregistered minimum number of completed runs, chosen because it is the smallest count that permits one run to be held out while two establish an orientation, define R[s,j,q] as the fraction of runs whose nonzero margin has the sign of a[s,j,q]; regimes with fewer runs contribute zero. Estimate the spurious-replication level R0[s,j,q] by P_perm=199 joint circular run-block permutations within q, the smallest odd count giving two-sided Monte Carlo resolution at most 0.01, where the same permutation is applied to every candidate field so candidate coupling and temporal blocks survive but observation-to-field alignment is broken. Set G[s,j,q]=a[s,j,q] max(0,R[s,j,q]-R0[s,j,q]) and the current-regime score S[s,q_t]=(|S|-1)^{-1} sum_{j!=s}G[s,j,q_t]; this is not covariance whitening, robust M-estimation, or change detection because the load-bearing artifact is candidate-pair orientation that exceeds a coupled block null. At update t, sort the existing values {Lsrc[s,t]} and assign them in descending order to candidates sorted by S[s,q_t], retaining the original candidate order for ties; this order transport defines Ltilde[s,t], exactly preserves the likelihood-value multiset, and becomes the sole M3 output consumed by the unchanged Bayesian accumulator and myopic action selector. The diagnostic leg evaluates the same G tensor with sequestered GADEN source identities only after all causal outputs are frozen, and M3 defaults to the identity assignment whenever all current-regime scores tie, providing a truth-blind activation boundary rather than a tuned posterior multiplier. Here R is the number of all completed runs with a nonzero margin whose sign equals sign(a), divided by the total completed-run count; for permutation p compute R^(p) by the same rule and define R0=P_perm^{-1} sum_p R^(p).
core_mechanism_reasoning:
BLOCK 1 — PREMISES ledger:
P1: Hit-transition runs separate plume intermittency contexts relevant to observed-to-modeled ordering; turbulent indoor plumes commonly alternate absence, onset, persistence, and exit, but whether those four contexts are sufficient is untested — falsification target.
P2: Pairwise orientation that repeats across completed runs beyond a coupled block-randomization null carries source-discriminative structure rather than house-specific correlation; plausible from repeated plume encounters, but untested — falsification target.
Observation-model premise: the UAV's samples are adaptively selected by the frozen planner and are neither iid nor unbiased samples of a house; the estimator therefore targets evidence conditional on the realized trajectory, and joint whole-run permutations preserve that selection and within-run dependence.
ESTIMAND: for each candidate pair and hit-transition regime on the realized causal path, G targets signed pairwise source-over-carrier dominance multiplied by replication in excess of the trajectory-conditional joint-block null.
BLOCK 2 — NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT: The runnable naive version sums e[s,t] globally for each candidate and reorders the current likelihood vector by that sum; branch (i), it fails because it assumes one stationary observed-to-modeled orientation across plume regimes, which is false in the target setting, so the proposed mechanism estimates orientation separately by hit-transition run and requires excess replication over a coupled null. Block randomization is a standard diagnostic tool, but this instance is not solved by an iid permutation test because all candidate fields share one adaptively chosen UAV path and turbulent blocks; the contribution uses a joint trajectory-preserving null to drive a candidate-label likelihood assignment, not merely a p-value.
BLOCK 3 — The two gaps share G: the method leg writes the reordered assignment from G, while the diagnostic leg destroys only G's observation-to-field alignment and measures the downstream consequence, so a separate detector module would duplicate machinery. Global empirical ranks, covariance whitening, Huber-style clipping, and CUSUM segmentation were rejected because they respectively occupy the closest frontier or regress to the lineage's collateral nodes; extra lookahead was rejected by the held-out horizon-2 result and the user's hard exclusions.
core_mechanism_steps:
1. Read the frozen M1/M2 causal log at each update t: h_t, Lsrc[:,t], Lcar[:,t], candidate identifiers, and the realized UAV path; emit no truth fields to the M3 process.
2. Convert h into q_t=(h_{t-1},h_t), close maximal runs when q changes, and store only completed past runs; output a causal run index keyed by the four regimes.
3. Compute e[:,u] for samples in completed runs and then every m[s,j,q,b]; output the ordered-pair run-margin table.
4. For each q with at least n_run completed runs, compute a and R; output observed pair orientations and their across-run replication.
5. Apply P_perm joint circular run-block permutations within q and compute R0 and G; output the excess-replicated dominance tensor while preserving candidate coupling and the fixed path.
6. If the candidate count is less than two, set the fallback flag and output the identity assignment. Otherwise compute S[:,q_t]; if all scores tie or q_t lacks n_run completed runs, set the fallback flag and output the identity assignment, otherwise clear the flag and output the stable descending S order, retaining original candidate order within score ties.
7. If the fallback flag is set, define Ltilde[:,t]=Lsrc[:,t] without sorting. Otherwise stable-sort the original Lsrc[:,t] values in descending order and assign them by the M3 candidate order to form Ltilde[:,t]; output exactly the original multiset under a possibly different candidate labeling.
8. Pass Ltilde[:,t], rather than Lsrc[:,t], into the unchanged Bayesian update; the resulting candidate posterior and hence the unchanged myopic action ranking can change only through this pre-accumulation reassignment.
9. Re-run the identical offline path for the identity baseline, the naive global-evidence reorder, and a negative control that substitutes one sampled block-permutation G for observed G; output frozen per-step candidate and action ranks for each arm.
10. After freezing outputs, expose the H02/H03 GADEN source identity only to the evaluator, score the existing 106 comparisons, and authorize runtime integration only if the observed-G arm improves source-order win rate over myopic while the block-permuted arm does not.
falsification_prediction: Replay the frozen M1/M2 H02/H03 logs causally through myopic, naive-global, observed-G, and block-permuted-G arms, freeze all ranks, and only then let the evaluator read GADEN source identities for the existing 106 comparisons. If the mechanism works, held-out source-order win rate for observed-G rises relative to myopic while the likelihood-value multiset remains identical at every update. The load-bearing variable is the excess-replicated dominance tensor G: replacing it with a jointly block-permuted G should return downstream source-order win rate toward or below myopic, whereas an order-only positive control using S without original likelihood magnitudes should preserve the direction of the gain. The claim is falsified before runtime integration if observed-G fails to improve that downstream metric, if the randomized-G control improves similarly, or if gains occur only in one house-defined stratum rather than across the preregistered H02/H03 comparison set.
compute_budget: 0.2 GPU-day on one 80GB-class GPU (the replay is expected to be CPU-dominated) + $0 API; comfortable within the stated envelope, including the 199-permutation controls and one full rerun for implementation verification.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: That method globally ranks accumulated observed and modeled concentrations, whereas this candidate constructs hit-transition-run pairwise source-over-carrier dominance, subtracts a coupled block null, and uses it only to reassign an unchanged likelihood-value multiset.

That method contrasts a probabilistic gas-hit map with online candidate simulations, whereas this candidate measures whether candidate preference replicates beyond trajectory-preserving spurious correlation before allowing those existing likelihood values to change source order.

That study changes planning horizon through a learned far-sighted policy while retaining its evidence model, whereas this candidate freezes the myopic planner and changes only the pre-Bayesian candidate assignment of existing evidence values.

what_step_was_missed: It would have needed to replace one globally pooled observation-to-model rank relation with causal hit-transition-run pairwise source-over-carrier orientations, test their replication against a coupled block null, and use the surviving orientation to permute candidate identities without changing likelihood magnitudes.
